lore.lore_founding_gap: The town's records skip a winter in its founding years. Nobody teaches why.
lore.lore_missing_people: The 1980s town rolls are full of students who 'moved away'. Too many, too young.
lore.lore_yearbook: An old yearbook with every face cut out except the vice principal's, thirty years younger.
lore.lore_forge: The forge went cold once, long ago, 'for a reason'. The blacksmith won't say what.
lore.lore_forge_apology: In the Upside-Down, the blacksmith's younger voice apologizes for letting the fire die.
lore.lore_reyes_log: Dr. Reyes keeps a private log of anomalies going back years.
lore.lore_marlowe: The library holds the history the school board didn't approve.
lore.lore_marlowe_notes: Ms. Marlowe has been quietly documenting strange nights for years.
lore.lore_nonsense_winter: Ms. Nonsense admits the bad winter wasn't about weather.
lore.lore_nonsense_upside: Ms. Nonsense knows the Upside-Down by name, and has known for a long time.
lore.lore_theo_mirror: Theo's theory: the Upside-Down is a mirror with a delay.
lore.lore_kris_maps: Old town maps show buildings that were never built. Their outlines match the Upside-Down.
lore.lore_lost_student: A student in a letterman jacket, decades out of date, says the vice principal 'transferred' him.

unlocks.text: You've died once. Mornings are a rumor.
After Kelly, you choose your words carefully.
Survived a week. Up before the alarm.
You know too much to walk in confidently.
